current_scope: Three existing public PTCL synthetic cases checked. Twelve first-line synthetic variations of age 18/45/65 and ECOG 0/1 across CD30-negative/positive profiles are now protected by mandatory CI regression. This is not a complete PTCL treatment-source or all-patient audit.

locators: Consolidative auto-HSCT in the first response
primary_guideline.paraphrase: The guideline permits consideration of autologous consolidation for responding high-risk limited-stage or advanced PTCL-NOS/TFHL. Its randomized-study summary describes similar EFS/OS, lower relapse with allo-HSCT but higher transplant-related mortality. It does not substantiate a routine allo-CR1 preference or general auto-HSCT inferiority. Do not extrapolate recommendations for ATLL, HSTCL or relapsed disease to newly diagnosed PTCL-NOS.

trial_retrieval_limit.citation: Schmitz et al., Blood 2021; DOI 10.1182/blood.2020008825; PMID 33512419
trial_retrieval_limit.source_of_findings: Guideline summary and reference list only
trial_retrieval_limit.reason: PMC returned recaptcha; publisher and PubMed retrieval did not provide full trial content. No claim of direct trial schedule/population reconciliation.

findings.problem: Indication and regimen assert routine allo-SCT in CR1 and general superiority over auto-SCT without a traceable supporting trial/cohort. Strong recommendation and five-year comparative outcome estimates are not supported by the reviewed source.

Conditioning and allo-HCT phases are mandatory, with fixed age-based pathways/donor hierarchy, while the primary basis for this first-line pathway is disputed. These require broader pathway review, not just monitor substitution.
Historical allo record inherits MON-R-CHOP-REGIMEN, including B-cell/CD20/DLBCL/double-hit/IPI/CNS-IPI checkpoints. Ordinary PTCL routes use their distinct CHOEP/BV-CHP monitors.
Historical transplant watchpoints include same-day fever above 38 degrees C and cycle-day-7-to-14 restriction. Patient advice, conditioning, donor rules and availability claims remain unreviewed.

verification.patient_data: Synthetic only; original profile files preserved

required_followup: Correct or quarantine the misleading historical indication/regimen together with source provenance and public reference copy

Ensure forced/historical selection cannot bypass source restrictions before enabling a clinical route
Only then author induction monitoring and specialist transplant handoff; do not claim R-CHOP monitor substitution validates transplantation
Review direct trial/current transplant recommendations and subtype-specific context
Refresh affected Wiki/source archives and translations when clinical records change; no protected HTML reads
